g1_loop#3.closest: Modular representation and control of floppy networks (2022) https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.03150 (rigidity floppy modes and self-stress in physical networks, no ML generation) ; Latent Constraints: Learning to Generate Conditionally from Unconditional Generative Models (2017) https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.05772
g1_loop#3.new: Applying Maxwell-Calladine rigidity analysis (Jacobian null and left-null space) to a model's concept-constraint graph, moving generation along floppy modes, and pinning verified directions as new constraint nodes while pruning self-stressed ones; I found no ML precedent, only generic null-space and tangent-space sampling in diffusion and latent models.

g1_core#1.new: Building a candidate as a growing partial object where each added condition must break a listed concept cluster's defining feature while a solver or prover certifies joint consistency, with the ordering adapting to which concepts are not yet escaped; the generic "violate a rule yet stay valid" idea is old, the solver-checked cluster-escape loop is not.
